build_ImageFeatureModule: build an ImageFeatureModule to project 3D seed points to 2D image space and extract image votes
build_ImageMLPModule: build an ImageMLPModule with two conv1d layers and batch normalization for processing image features
run_append_img_feat: run append_img_feat to fuse image features with 3D point cloud geometric, semantic, and texture cues
review_ImageFeatureModule_forward: review the ImageFeatureModule forward pass that computes UV coordinates and gathers per-pixel image votes
refactor_ImageMLPModule: refactor the ImageMLPModule to adjust input dimensions or hidden layer size for image feature processing
